test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the 'Doongri Festival' of Himachal Pradesh?

options.text: It is celebrated in honour of Hidimba Devi [wife of Bhima].
It is dedicated to the Goddess of wealth.
It marks the beginning of the Tibetan year.
It is celebrated in honour of Lord Shiva.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is celebrated in honour of Hidimba Devi [wife of Bhima]**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Doongri Festival** is a famous festival celebrated in the state of **Himachal Pradesh**, particularly in the **Kullu Valley**.
 
• The festival is held to honor **Hidimba Devi**, who is regarded as a local deity and the wife of **Bhima**, one of the Pandavas in the epic **Mahabharata**.
 
• The **Hidimba Devi Temple**, also known as the **Doongri Temple**, serves as the focal point of this festival. It is an ancient wooden temple located in **Manali**.
 
• The festival usually occurs in the spring season and is marked by traditional dances, music, and rituals</strong&
